title: Product Service Provider's Obligation to Conform to Express Warranty

content.scenario: Rahul purchased a smartphone from a retailer with a one-year warranty. However, the phone's battery started draining quickly within six months. The retailer refused to replace the battery, citing that it was not a manufacturing defect.
content.outcome: The retailer is liable for not conforming to the express warranty, as the service provided (the smartphone) did not meet the quality required by the contract (the one-year warranty). The consumer (Rahul) can file a complaint against the retailer for product liability.

user_queries: What happens if a product does not meet the express warranty?
Can a consumer file a complaint for product liability?
What are the obligations of a product service provider?
